I need to take out #b150 Plateons#k and collect #b120 Mecateon's Laser Guns#k for him.

descriptions.completed: Just the way the mission stated by Green Mesoranger of Boswell Field, I took out the Plateons and collected Mecateon's laser guns. Green Mesoranger seemed genuinely surprised by the fact that I took care of all the missions, and told me it'd be a pleasure to work with me again. Now, THAT felt good!
